name: Avalion
summary: Avalion is a continent-scale fantasy world for the prototype. Major regions, capitals, cities, border sites, and travel anchors are fixed so the backend and narrator share a stable geography. Smaller villages, local NPCs, ruins, caves, and one-off scene locations may still be generated by the AI, but important or recurring places should be persisted.

notes: Coordinates are calibrated against the 1536x1024 Avalion map image.
The map uses a 150 by 100 coordinate grid to preserve the image aspect ratio.
One coordinate point is approximately 10 km, so the full map is about 1500 km wide and 1000 km tall.
Travel routes can override straight-line distance when roads, mountains, rivers, sea travel, or story gates matter.
The Shard Isles require sea travel, air travel, flight, teleportation, or another valid crossing method.

regions.name: Crownfields
regions.terrain: fertile plains, river roads, farm towns, fortified trade roads
regions.description: The human heartland sits between forest, mountains, and coast. It is the safest starting region and the strongest trade hub, but its roads still need guards, messengers, and problem solvers.

locations.name: Crownford
locations.description: The central human capital and neutral political anchor of the Crownfields.

locations.name: Willowbrook
locations.description: A busy starter city with taverns, markets, simple work, and roads into the wider realm.

locations.name: Greyharbor
locations.description: A salt-stained port city and the main legal sea route toward the Shard Isles.

locations.name: Ironford
locations.description: A fortified river crossing where human caravans meet dwarf trade from the peaks.

locations.name: Southmarket
locations.description: A large agricultural market town known for grain, livestock, and seasonal fairs.

locations.name: Millhaven
locations.description: A river-mill settlement that feeds Willowbrook and offers simple local contracts.

locations.name: Westbridge
locations.description: A bridge town guarding the western road between the coast, forest, and capital.

locations.name: Appleford
locations.description: A small orchard village used as a low-risk rural quest anchor.

locations.name: Thornwick
locations.description: A rougher farming village near contested roads and beast-haunted thickets.

locations.name: Sun Monastery
locations.description: A hilltop monastery, useful for healing, lore, discipline, and teacher NPCs.

locations.name: Duskmire Watch
locations.description: A border watch post between human roads, dwarf passes, and orc raiding routes.

locations.name: Starspire
locations.description: A neutral tower of scholars and mages, placed between human and elven influence.

locations.name: Greenwatch
locations.description: A ranger lodge at the edge of Silverwood, watching the forest border.

regions.name: Silverwood
regions.terrain: ancient forest, moonlit glades, misty springs, hidden paths
regions.description: The elven northwest is dense, beautiful, and guarded by old paths. It should feel magical and alive, with cities grown into the forest rather than built over it.

locations.name: Lythariel
locations.description: The elven capital, a luminous city of living wood, silver bridges, and moonlit halls.

locations.name: Aeloria
locations.description: A high-canopy city known for archers, scouts, and skywalks between ancient trees.

locations.name: Thalanor
locations.description: An old elven city of lore keepers, healers, and ritual groves.

locations.name: Everspring
locations.description: A spring-fed forest town where travelers can enter Silverwood under watch.

locations.name: Moonwell
locations.description: A sacred moonlit well and recurring anchor for magical or spiritual quests.

locations.name: Silvershade
locations.description: A mist-covered village near the border of elven and human influence.

locations.name: Greenveil
locations.description: A guarded grove that controls peaceful passage from the Crownfields.

locations.name: Dawnleaf
locations.description: A quiet forest village suited for herbalists, hunters, and low-danger woodland quests.

regions.name: Stoneward Peaks
regions.terrain: mountains, fortress roads, deep mines, high passes
regions.description: The dwarven east is shaped by stone roads, deep halls, forge smoke, and defensible mountain routes. Travel here is slower and often route-based rather than straight-line.

locations.name: Stonewatch
locations.description: The dwarven capital fortress overlooking the high mountain roads.

locations.name: Deephall
locations.description: A subterranean city linked to mines, vaults, and underground trade.

locations.name: Hammerfall
locations.description: A major forge city famous for smiths, armorers, and weapon crafters.

locations.name: Frostgate
locations.description: A cold northern gate that watches the dangerous high passes.

locations.name: Ore Crown
locations.description: A rich mining hold and source of iron, silver, and rare ore.

locations.name: Ironbridge
locations.description: A great bridge and trade crossing between human lands and dwarf roads.

locations.name: Deepforge
locations.description: A deep forge hold for advanced crafting, repairs, and rare equipment.

locations.name: Stonepass
locations.description: A hard mountain pass settlement with scouts, guides, and caravan guards.

locations.name: Anvilwatch
locations.description: A southern dwarven watch fort facing the orc wastes.

regions.name: Grimscar Wastes
regions.terrain: red steppe, broken mesas, ash canyons, harsh strongholds
regions.description: The orc southeast is rough, exposed, and politically fragmented. It should feel dangerous but not mindless: strongholds, clans, hunters, and harsh honor all belong here.

locations.name: Kragmor
locations.description: The largest orc fortress, built from black timber, bone markers, and red stone.

locations.name: Gorath
locations.description: A rough trade city and clan meeting ground near the human border.

locations.name: Bloodmesa
locations.description: A mesa city known for arena trials, hunters, and warband contracts.

locations.name: Ashdur
locations.description: A canyon city surrounded by ash dunes, smoke vents, and rough roads.

locations.name: Redrock Pass
locations.description: The main land pass from human roads into the orc wastes.

locations.name: Thorncamp
locations.description: A movable camp and useful anchor for scouts, hunters, and caravan trouble.

locations.name: Redscar
locations.description: A fortified stronghold watching the northern edge of the wastes.

locations.name: Black Gorge
locations.description: A narrow gorge settlement with dangerous vertical paths.

locations.name: Stormhold
locations.description: A southern fort battered by dry storms and clan conflicts.

regions.name: Shard Isles
regions.terrain: jagged islands, marsh channels, wreck coasts, reef caves
regions.description: The goblin island chain is reachable only by valid crossing methods. It should support ship routes, scavenger ports, strange mechanics, and chaotic but clever settlements.
regions.travel_requirement: ship, airship, flying mount, teleportation, or equivalent crossing method

locations.name: Jagged Harbor
locations.description: The main goblin port city, loud with cranes, scrap markets, and crooked docks.

locations.name: Cauldron Marsh
locations.description: A bubbling marsh settlement of alchemists, fishers, and risky shortcuts.

locations.name: Rust Quay
locations.description: A rusted harbor city filled with salvaged metal, mechanics, and shipwrights.

locations.name: Splinterport
locations.description: A cramped port town spread across sharp islets and rope bridges.

locations.name: Crowfen
locations.description: A muddy village hidden in reeds, fog, and half-sunk boardwalks.

locations.name: Wreck Bay
locations.description: A bay of broken ships and scavenger crews.

locations.name: Rust Caves
locations.description: A cave settlement used for tinkering, smuggling, and hidden workshops.

locations.name: Mudspire
locations.description: A leaning tower-village built from mud brick, driftwood, and salvaged beams.

locations.name: Blackreef
locations.description: A dangerous outer reef outpost for smugglers, scouts, and sea threats.
